DitherTabs.variant: pill lights a dithered surface behind the label. underline draws a dithered bar with a rising glow.
DitherTabs.color: Indicator colour, such as one from DitherPalette.
DitherTabs.bloom: low or high adds a soft glow in the indicator's colour.
DitherTabs.animated: Glides the indicator between tabs over 260 ms.
DitherTabs.changed: Called with the index of the tab that was chosen.
